units.function: End-to-end service/route tests for resolving, listing, previewing and downloading local workspace files with tenant, path, content, audit and resource-consumption guards.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express -> file-resource routes/limiters -> workspace-file service -> Drizzle/PostgreSQL + local filesystem/Git/stream; remote providers are deliberately not fetched and all Agent Web access is denied.
units.keyDataModels: Company/Goal/Project/Work and project/execution workspace, file/directory/remote resource capability, workspace selector/path/search/list page, preview encoding/content type/size, activity record and in-process request/concurrency limiter.
units.lifecycle: Authorize owning Work/company -> select execution/project or discover another company workspace -> validate and realpath resource -> list/preview/stream under caps -> return sanitized display metadata -> audit success/denial while holding concurrency through download completion.
units.testAssessment: All 31 tests are behind embedded-Postgres gating and skipped in both sandboxed and approved unsandboxed focused runs. The source suite is broad and security-aware, but none of its database, filesystem, Git, HTTP, FIFO, audit or limiter assertions executed locally.
units.designRationale: Offer a bounded human workspace viewer without exposing host paths or fetching remote resources, fail closed on ambiguous/escaping/sensitive paths, keep active content out of previews and control expensive recursive/streaming access with separate limits.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs Artifact/Evidence access that is explicitly authorized by company data contracts, purpose and responsibility—not ambient filesystem browsing—and must produce immutable provenance/hash/access receipts while protecting customer-local execution nodes.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT the authority and artifact model. ADAPT the path/content test matrix, uniform tenant handling, sanitized display metadata, remote no-fetch rule, bounded listing, active-content handling, stream-lifetime concurrency and safe audit-field discipline. Require an ArtifactRef issued by a Connector/runtime, bind it to Work/Attempt/DataAuthorization, open by stable handle, enforce classification/size/expiry and record digest/bytes/actor/purpose.
units.responsibilityConflict: Same-company board access is sufficient for automatic and explicit cross-project file discovery, with no accountable data owner, ResponsibilityContract, DataAuthorization or approval. A file path is treated as a discoverable convenience resource rather than a declared evidence/data object, so successful access cannot answer why that person was authorized to view or export it.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL authorization conflict: company membership permits unique cross-project file auto-discovery and explicit reads without DataAuthorization or project/data-owner approval. HIGH local-root trust gap: configured workspace-root provenance and host-directory scope are untested. HIGH TOCTOU gap: static symlink tests do not prove race-safe descriptor opening. HIGH resource-exhaustion gap: media preview/download byte and duration limits, disconnect handling and distributed quotas are untested. HIGH evidence gap: reads/downloads lack immutable content digest, byte count, purpose and authorization receipt. MEDIUM sensitive-path coverage: examples cover .env/.git but broader credential/config classifications are not demonstrated. MEDIUM verification gap: all tests skipped locally.
